notes: Intro: outreach from product lead (Katrina) — wants to replace existing rule-based autoresponders with an agent that can call order APIs.
Primary ask: post-purchase chat/agent for returns + shipping updates. Must return actionable steps (start return, print label, escalate to ops).
Latency: require p95 end-to-end <250ms for streaming tokens on standard queries; 95th for tool-calling flows <400ms (including order lookup).
Seasonality: heavy spikes during Nov-Dec (peak concurrent sessions ~6x baseline). Need autoscaling behavior and predictable billing for peak windows.
Model preferences: prefer open model variants or Redwood-verified small-medium models; interested in 8-bit/quantized variants to reduce cost if quality ok.
Routing: want fallback to cheaper model during low-priority queries and automatic regional failover (NA primary, EU residency for EU users).
Security: legal requires SOC2 and audit logs, SSO via SAML, optional HSM/KMS for key management, 6 month message retention policy configurable.
POC notes: 2-week POC split: week1 functional (tool-calling + structured outputs), week2 perf (streaming latency + load test during synthetic holiday spike).
Demo feedback 2026-02-10: liked streaming partials, tool-calling hooks worked for order lookup but KV cache miss rate high on long sessions. SE suggested prefix caching and stickiness by session id.
Quote from Katrina: "We need the agent to feel instant for customers — even during CyberWeek. If p95 slips we see CS escalations same day."
Internal: finance flagged ARR estimate vs expected cost — cost sensitivity moderate, will consider 12 month reserved commit for Dedicated if unit economics acceptable.

Open asks to Redwood: provide canary + fallback story for model degradation, example SLOs under x% cold-start rate, dedicated pricing tiers for 2/4/8 GPU pools, and baseline token cost estimate for our workload.
